name: Signer: Sign PDF Documents
description: Sign PDFs on your iPhone: place your signature or initials, fill in text, dates and checkmarks, scan paper, and share the signed PDF. It appears on your Home Screen as Signer.
availability: In beta testing on TestFlight. Coming soon to the App Store for iPhone.

source_review.app_privacy: App Store Connect App Privacy as read back 2026-09-29 03:02Z (factory rule v2): User ID and Device ID for Analytics and App Functionality; Product Interaction, Other Usage Data and Coarse Location for Analytics; Purchase History for App Functionality and Analytics; all Data Linked to You, no tracking
